SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
    SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y', t.Date)
ORDER BY 
    TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TransactionCount
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'Czech Republic' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS PercentageOfCustomersUsingEUR
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.Date = '2012-08-25';

INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND m.position = 'Student_Club' AND m.t_shirt_size = 'M';

FROM event e
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM attendance a
    WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id
) > 20
AND e.type != 'fundraiser';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    budget b
JOIN 
    event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE 
    e.event_name = 'Student_Club';

SELECT major.department
FROM member
INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'President';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
INNER JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
ORDER BY b.spent ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS attended
FROM 
    member m
INNER JOIN 
    attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
INNER JOIN 
    event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE 
    m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'game'
  AND status = 'closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 1;

SELECT P.ID, 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.FG > 0;

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS member_name, e.cost
FROM member m
INNER JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.expense_description = 'water, veggie tray and supplies';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'In-patient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'Out-patient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'In-patients' 
        ELSE 'Out-patients' 
    END AS Majority,
    ABS(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'In-patient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'Out-patient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
    ) AS Deviation
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'Male';

SELECT 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS Age, 
    Patient.Diagnosis 
FROM 
    Patient 
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory 
ON 
    Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
ORDER BY 
    Laboratory.HGB DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MaleToFemaleRatio
FROM 
    Patient P
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    L.UA IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE (julianday(E.`Examination Date`) - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365 < 18
AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1993-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
  AND L.`T-BIL` BETWEEN 0.3 AND 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    (Nov.T-CHO - Dec.T-CHO) * 100.0 / Nov.T-CHO AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    (SELECT T-CHO 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE strftime('%m', Date) = '11' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981' AND ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')) AS Nov,
    (SELECT T-CHO 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE strftime('%m', Date) = '12' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981' AND ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')) AS Dec;

SELECT P.SEX, AVG(L.`T-BIL`) AS Average_T_BIL
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` NOT BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT T2.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS matches_won
FROM `Match` AS M
INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T2.team_long_name
ORDER BY matches_won DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.birthday) AS Age
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97 AND PA.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT AVG(M.home_team_goal) AS average_home_goals
FROM `Match` M
INNER JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Poland' AND M.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date = '2016-06-23'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT T1.code
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.raceId = 45 AND T2.q3 = '0:01:33';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, SUM(T2.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
GROUP BY T1.driverId
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2009;

SELECT r.name AS race_name, res.points
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.fastestLapSpeed) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2009;

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
  drivers d
  INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  INNER JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
  d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008
),
first_place AS (
  SELECT T1.driverId, T1.time AS first_place_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN race_info AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = 1
),
last_place AS (
  SELECT T1.driverId, T1.time AS last_place_time
  FROM results AS T1
  INNER JOIN race_info AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
  WHERE T1.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info))
)
SELECT 
  ((julianday(lp.last_place_time) - julianday(fp.first_place_time)) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) / julianday(lp.last_place_time) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM first_place AS fp, last_place AS lp;

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    drivers d
INNER JOIN 
    lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
INNER JOIN 
    races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    AND lt.lap > 50;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes);

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Blue' AND c2.colour = 'Blonde';

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Copycat';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm = 185 AND race.race = 'Human';

SELECT 
    c_eye.colour AS eye_colour, 
    c_hair.colour AS hair_colour, 
    c_skin.colour AS skin_colour
FROM 
    superhero s
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_hair ON s.hair_colour_id = c_hair.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
INNER JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
INNER JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    g.gender = 'Female' 
    AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_female_marvel
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id;

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025 AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39';

WITH BadgeCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', Date) AS Year,
        COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date)
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2011' THEN BadgeCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2010' THEN BadgeCount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(BadgeCount) AS PercentageDifference
FROM BadgeCounts;

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p 
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mornington') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(p.ViewCount) 
     FROM posts p 
     JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
     WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Amos') AS ViewCountDifference;

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS Percentage
FROM 
    posts p
INNER JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE 
    p.CreaionDate BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31';

SELECT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.power IS NULL AND l.format = 'Commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS french_percentage
FROM 
    cards c
INNER JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE 
    c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN layout != 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS proportion_non_normal_layout
FROM cards;

SELECT DISTINCT c.types
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE f.language = 'de';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
INNER JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code 
WHERE sets.name = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND cards.artist = 'Adam Rex';

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'Triple' AND m.label LIKE '%carcinogenic%';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Serra Angel') > 
             (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Shrine Keeper') 
        THEN 'Serra Angel'
        ELSE 'Shrine Keeper'
    END AS card_with_higher_converted_mana_cost;

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_percentage
FROM 
  molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
  m.label = 'TR206';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id BETWEEN '21' AND '25';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple-bond' AND a.element IN ('phosphorus', 'bromine');

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.Street 
FROM 
    schools s 
INNER JOIN 
    frpm f 
ON 
    s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode 
WHERE 
    ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule m
JOIN connected c ON m.molecule_id = c.atom_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND c.atom_id = '12';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName1 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName1
        WHEN sc.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName2 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName2
        WHEN sc.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND sc.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL THEN sc.AdmFName3 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName3
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools sc
INNER JOIN 
    satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  s.School, 
  AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_Writing_Score
FROM 
  schools s
INNER JOIN 
  satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
  s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY 
  s.School;

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSchools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'N'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY NumberOfSchools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN trans t ON c.district_id = t.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.district_id
    HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 6000 AND AVG(t.amount) < 10000
) AS filtered_districts;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district, 
    d.A3 AS state, 
    ((d.A16 - d.A15) / d.A15) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_change
FROM 
    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
INNER JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.status = 'active' 
    AND l.amount > l.payments;

WITH ClientSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
),
YoungestClients AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(c.birth_date) AS min_birth_date
    FROM 
        client c
)
SELECT 
    a.account_id
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN 
    ClientSalary cs ON c.client_id = cs.client_id
JOIN 
    YoungestClients yc ON c.birth_date = yc.min_birth_date
WHERE 
    cs.avg_salary = (SELECT MAX(avg_salary) FROM ClientSalary)

WITH HighSalaryDistricts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE (A2 + A3 + A4 + A5 + A6 + A7 + A8 + A9 + A10 + A11 + A12 + A13 + A14 + A15 + A16) / 15.0 > 10000
),
FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_count
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM HighSalaryDistricts)
      AND gender = 'W'
),
TotalClients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM HighSalaryDistricts)
)
SELECT (CAST(female_count AS REAL) * 100 / total_count) AS percentage_female
FROM FemaleClients, TotalClients;

SELECT AVG(d.A16) AS average_crimes
FROM district d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE (d.A2 > 4000 OR d.A3 > 4000 OR d.A4 > 4000 OR d.A5 > 4000 OR d.A6 > 4000 OR d.A7 > 4000 OR d.A8 > 4000 OR d.A9 > 4000 OR d.A10 > 4000 OR d.A11 > 4000 OR d.A12 > 4000 OR d.A13 > 4000 OR d.A14 > 4000 OR d.A15 > 4000 OR d.A16 > 4000)
AND a.date >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'running' AND t.date > l.date;

SELECT 
    a.account_id, 
    d.A2 AS district_name, 
    d.A16 AS district_region
FROM 
    account a
INNER JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' 
    AND a.date > t.date;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS PatientCount
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND L.GPT > 30
  AND L.ALB < 4;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS Female_Percentage
FROM 
    Patient
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' 
    AND Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.WBC IS NOT NULL AND (L.FG < 2.0 OR L.FG > 4.0);

SELECT 
    T2.team_short_name, 
    T1.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM 
    Team_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
ORDER BY 
    T1.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'
AND T2.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'
)

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_players
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
AND pa.defensive_work_rate > pa.attacking_work_rate;

SELECT 
    MAX(TA.chanceCreationPassing) AS highest_chance_creation_passing,
    TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM 
    Team_Attributes TA
INNER JOIN 
    Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE 
    T.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY 
    TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.strength DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team AS T
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND TA.date = '2015-09-10';

SELECT 
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM 
    Team t
INNER JOIN 
    Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE 
    t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT q1
FROM qualifying
INNER JOIN drivers ON qualifying.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Bruno' AND drivers.surname = 'Senna' AND qualifying.raceId = 354;

SELECT seasons.url
FROM races
INNER JOIN seasons ON races.year = seasons.year
WHERE races.raceId = 901;

SELECT 
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_completion_rate
FROM 
    races ra
INNER JOIN 
    results r ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
INNER JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE 
    ra.date = '1983-07-16'
GROUP BY 
    d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname;

SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    r.name AS race_name,
    lt.milliseconds AS best_lap_time
FROM 
    lapTimes lt
INNER JOIN 
    drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
INNER JOIN 
    races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
ORDER BY 
    lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location AS circuit_location
FROM races r
INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2005 AND r.date LIKE '2005-09%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId) AS total_drivers
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2008;

SELECT AVG(results.fastestLapSpeed) AS average_fastest_lap_speed
FROM results
INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 2009 AND races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT d.driverId, d.code
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND r.fastestLap = 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue' AND sp.power_name = 'Agility';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY 
    s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    superhero s
INNER JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
AND eye_colour_id IS NULL;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_marvel
FROM 
    superhero s
INNER JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_powers
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Amazo';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
INNER JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Blue' AND c2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM (
  SELECT UserId
  FROM badges
  GROUP BY UserId
  HAVING COUNT(Id) > 5
) AS UsersWithMoreThan5Badges;

SELECT AVG(MonthlyLinkCount) AS AverageMonthlyLinkCount
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS Month, COUNT(pl.Id) AS MonthlyLinkCount
  FROM postLinks pl
  INNER JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
  WHERE p.AnswerCount <= 2 AND strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'
  GROUP BY Month
) AS MonthlyCounts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
GROUP BY u.Id
HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4;

SELECT posts.Id, users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY posts.Score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  AVG(p.UpVotes) AS AverageUpVotes,
  AVG(u.Age) AS AverageAge
FROM 
  users u
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
      OwnerUserId,
      COUNT(*) AS PostCount,
      SUM(CASE WHEN VoteTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UpVotes
    FROM 
      posts p
      INNER JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
    GROUP BY 
      OwnerUserId
    HAVING 
      COUNT(*) > 10
  ) p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CommentCount
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  ORDER BY Score DESC
  LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ZeroScoreComments
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1 AND c.Score = 0;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS borderless_percentage
FROM 
    cards;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
INNER JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE legalities.status = 'Banned' AND cards.borderColor = 'White';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
INNER JOIN 
    foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE 
    c.power IS NULL;

SELECT fd.language
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'A Pedra Fellwar';

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy');

SELECT st.translation
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND st.language = 'Italian';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label != 'Carcinogenic'
GROUP BY T1.element
ORDER BY atom_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams' AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT 
  b.bond_type AS majority_bond_type,
  'Unknown' AS carcinogenicity
FROM 
  bond b
WHERE 
  b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
  b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
  COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  b.bond_type,
  a1.element AS atom1_element,
  a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM 
  bond b
  INNER JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  INNER JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  INNER JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id != a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'P' AND a2.element = 'N') OR (a1.element = 'N' AND a2.element = 'P');

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM 
  atom a
  INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = 'single';

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.FundingType
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, 
    s.FundingType
HAVING 
    AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS AverageTestTakers
FROM schools sch
INNER JOIN satscores s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.City = 'Fresno' AND sch.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY Longitude DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS Month, 
    COUNT(*) AS MonthlyAverage
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Alameda' 
    AND DOC = 'Elementary School District' 
    AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%m', OpenDate)
ORDER BY 
    Month;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON c.client_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A2 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.type = 'salary'
GROUP BY c.client_id
HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 8000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT 
    disp.type, 
    AVG(district.A12) AS average_income
FROM 
    disp
INNER JOIN 
    account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    disp.type != 'loan' 
    AND district.A12 > 8000 
    AND district.A12 <= 9000
GROUP BY 
    disp.type;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.type = 'Withdrawal' AND t.operation = 'Cash';

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1997
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN 
        loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M' 
        AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    (total_1997 - total_1996) * 100.0 / total_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan_totals
WHERE 
    total_1996 > 0;

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'high';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';
